claims: Kohl's is not planning additional store closures in 2026.
Kohl's shut down 27 underperforming stores by April 2025.
The 2025 closures spanned 15 states, according to WWD and CNN.
There were significant cuts in California in the 2025 closures, according to WWD and CNN.
CEO Michael J. Bender stated there is no "grand plan" to close more stores in 2026.
27 stores closed by April 2025, representing less than 3% of Kohl's 1,150+ locations.
Kohl's stores closed in San Diego, California in 2025.
Kohl's stores closed in Encinitas, California in 2025.
Kohl's stores closed in Fremont, California in 2025.
Kohl's stores closed in Alabama in 2025.
Kohl's stores closed in Virginia in 2025.
A Kohl's fulfillment center in San Bernardino, California closed in May 2025.
